minutes.headline: Select Board recommended the FY15 town budget, capital plan and sewer extension for Town Meeting and signed the warrant.
minutes.summary: The board heard a student's clothing-drive project, approved a Boys and Girls Club yard sale and a solar door-to-door license, and set an April 29 hearing for a public way. It reviewed the FY14 budget adjustment estimate and the Finance Committee's FY15 changes, then recommended the budget, capital plan, bus fee offset fund, cemetery article and the Sewer Commission's articles. The warrant was signed and the board went into executive session on the teachers' contract.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to recommend the FY15 budget article to Town Meeting.
The board recommended the capital planning report, the student transportation offset receipt fund article and the cemetery lot sales article.
The board recommended the Sewer Commission's sewer extension article and sewer budget article, with the extension described as covered by an SRF loan and betterments, not taxpayers.
The board signed the warrant as presented with changes, then went into executive session on the teachers' contract.
The board also discussed paying the Monty Tech supplemental assessment in FY14 to free funds in FY15, and leaned toward leaving any freed money with education.

why_it_matters: The budget, capital plan and sewer articles recommended here are the ones residents will be asked to vote on at Town Meeting, and they set the town budget, mostly taxes, for FY15.

The bus fee offset fund would keep bus fee revenue in its own fund to offset the transportation contract, and the sewer extension is described as paid through loan and betterments rather than the tax bill.
